source.title: Jeff Booth Warning: The Scenario Nobody in Bitcoin Wants to Talk About
source.description:
Are we headed toward a future of abundance and freedom...or control and scarcity? 

Jeff Booth joins me to revisit The Price of Tomorrow and explore how AI, government control, and a broken financial system are shaping our future—and why he believes Bitcoin offers a way out.

In this episode:
• Can Bitcoin succeed but we still lose our freedom?
• Who holds the power if AI does all the work?
• Why Jeff questions what elections can really change
• Wall Street’s Bitcoin versus Main Street’s Bitcoin
• What Jeff sees beyond the price chart
• Could Bitcoin power a new kind of internet?

Follow Jeff
